Optional Solvers
==----

CBMPy supports additional solvers that require optional dependencies.

**CBCPLEX** - IBM CPLEX solver wrapper. Requires the IBM CPLEX Optimization Studio package. Source: ``cbmpy/CBCPLEX.py``.

**CBGLPKOLD** - Legacy GLPK wrapper. Requires an older version of the glpk package. Source: ``cbmpy/CBGLPKOLD.py``.
